subject: Symbol in legend do not match ones in the plot

messages.author: 757a42d1a356a239
messages.subject: Symbol in legend do not match ones in the plot
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

This is probably a newbie classic but I just cannot get my legend
symbols to follow the ones specified in the plot.
The very minimal reproducible code below should show my problem. the
legend shows the right colors but not matching sysmbols.,,

df1<-data.frame(cbind(seq(1:12), runif(12), runif(12)),
stringsAsFactors = F)
aa<-ggplot(df1, aes( x = X1)) +
geom_point(aes(y = X2, shape =2, colour = "first")) +
geom_point(aes(y = X3, shape =3, colour = "second")) +
scale_colour_manual("Measure", c("first" = "red", "second" = "blue"))

Any hints greatly appreciated.

---Jean

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: Symbol in legend do not match ones in the plot
parts:
It's much easier if you melt() your dataset

library(ggplot2)
df1 <- data.frame(cbind(seq(1:12), runif(12), runif(12)), stringsAsFactors = F)
colnames(df1)[2:3] <- c("first", "second")
Molten <- melt(df1, id.vars = "X1")
ggplot(Molten, aes(x = X1, y = value, colour = variable, shape = variable)) + geom_point()
ggplot(Molten, aes(x = X1, y = value, colour = variable, shape = variable)) + geom_point() + scale_colour_manual("Measure", c(first = "red", second = "blue")) + scale_shape_manual("Measure", c(first = 2, second = 3))

Best regards,

Thierry
